PASS|BLOCK_WINDOW_HASHED|Valid bytes and validity mask for each block window have digests.
PASS|BLOCK_COVERAGE_INTERSECTS_PARCEL|Only blocks intersecting the exact parcel window and mask are scheduled.

PASS|ONE_DATASET_PER_WORKER_FALLBACK|Unsupported wrappers fall back to separate worker dataset instances.
PASS|UNSAFE_SHARED_DATASET_REJECTED|Ordinary related dataset and band objects are not used concurrently.
PASS|DATASET_IDENTITY_EQUAL_ACROSS_WORKERS|Every worker reopens the same immutable asset identity.

PASS|TASK_SUBMISSION_ORDER_RECORDED|Submitted block IDs follow canonical ordering.

PASS|RESULTS_KEYED_BY_BLOCK_ID|Every future result is associated with its exact canonical block ID.
PASS|MISSING_BLOCK_RESULT_FAILS|A submitted block without exactly one successful result fails closed.
PASS|DUPLICATE_BLOCK_RESULT_FAILS|Multiple results for one block ID fail closed.
PASS|WORKER_EXCEPTION_PROPAGATES|Any read, mask, decode or reduction exception aborts acceptance.
PASS|TIMEOUT_CANCELS_AND_FAILS|Timed-out or cancelled block work cannot be silently omitted.
PASS|MERGE_ORDER_CANONICAL|Completed results are merged only after sorting by canonical block ID.
PASS|LOCAL_CELL_ORDER_ROW_MAJOR|Cells inside each block use stable row-major ordering.
PASS|GLOBAL_CELL_COORDINATES_RECONSTRUCTED|Block-local cells map exactly to global raster row and column.
PASS|ARGMIN_ARGMAX_NOT_SOLE_TIE_EVIDENCE|Single first-occurrence indices cannot represent all ties.
PASS|ALL_MINIMUM_TIES_MERGED|Every globally tied minimum cell is retained.
PASS|ALL_MAXIMUM_TIES_MERGED|Every globally tied maximum cell is retained.
PASS|TIE_ORDER_STABLE|Tie arrays sort by value class, global row, global column and source owner.
PASS|SERIAL_PARALLEL_VALID_COUNT_EQUAL|Accepted valid-cell counts are identical.
PASS|SERIAL_PARALLEL_VALUE_DIGEST_EQUAL|Ordered accepted raw or decoded value digests are identical.
PASS|SERIAL_PARALLEL_EXTREMA_EQUAL|Minimum, maximum and difference are identical under the declared numeric policy.
PASS|SERIAL_PARALLEL_TIES_EQUAL|All minimum and maximum tie records are identical.
PASS|NO_NUMERIC_ELEVATION_INVENTED|Numeric target elevation rows remain zero.
PASS|FINAL_READY_REMAINS_FALSE|Preparation does not satisfy runner execution or numeric target output.
